integrity: The exact reduction is proved by explicit trigonometric algebra, complete root ordering, and Kronecker--Weyl equidistribution. Finite numerical quadrature is used only to reproduce the decimal value.
scientific_limitations: The theorem evaluates the incommensurate high-energy density governed by equation (3.13) of the primary source; commensurate edge ratios are excluded.
No elementary or named-special-value closed form is claimed for the remaining one-dimensional integral.
The printed decimal is corroborative numerical quadrature; the exact scientific claim is the algebraic Cauchy reduction and integral representation.
title: Exact Cauchy reduction of the incommensurate Kagome spectral-density constant
